title: Doc: CCID desync flag permanent -- needs comment
description: In wp11_ccid.c, once ctx->desync is set to 1 on an IN transfer failure, it is never cleared. All subsequent wp11_ccid_apdu() calls fail immediately. This is a deliberate design choice (a desynced CCID framing layer cannot safely recover without closing and reopening the device), but there is no comment explaining the decision. A future maintainer may incorrectly attempt to add recovery logic. Fix: add a comment at the desync set site explaining that recovery requires closing and reopening the CCID context, and why.
